subject: general
question: What principal would amount to ₹21,420 in 2 years at the rate of 9.5% p.a. simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest for 2 years = 9.5% × 2 = 19%

Total Amount = Principal (100%) + Interest (19%) = 119% of Principal

119% of Principal → ₹21,420

100% of Principal → (21420 ÷ 119) × 100 = ₹18,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹21,420

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 9.5% p.a.

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P + SI = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d74e47be962e618ab5925e42a7265437e9f676e7923a8a15c9d5715aadef258.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount = P × (1 + (9.5 × 2) ÷ 100)

⇒ 21420 = P × (1 + 19 ÷ 100)

⇒ 21420 = P × (119 ÷ 100)

⇒ P = (21420 × 100) ÷ 119

⇒ P = 180 × 100

⇒ P = 18000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the initial principal. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount (A)

The total sum at the end of the specified time period. The basic formula is A = P + SI.

Effective SI Rate

In simple interest, the overall rate percent accumulated over T years is directly obtained by R × T percent.
